verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents an HTTP API for reading process guides and working with company context. It publishes a downloadable OpenAPI contract with request and response schemas, has an operations reference, and the CLI prints the hosted API's JSON Schema 2020-12 input contracts without login. Agent-friendly surfaces (JSON CLI output, a hosted MCP endpoint with a standard OAuth resource-metadata flow) reinforce the programmatic path. Hosted operations sit behind login, which is normal API auth. The probe-2 404s checked other paths, not the documented /contracts/openapi.json location, so they do not contradict the docs. Missing for 10: a hands-on authenticated call against the HTTP API, and independent retrieval of the documented OpenAPI contract file. [2026-10-08 adversarial bias audit (owner-product bring-up lane): quality 8 -> 6 — the judged rationale leaned on the 404s not covering the documented /contracts/openapi.json location; the audit fetched that documented location and it answers 404 {"code":"NOT_FOUND"} (2026-10-08), so the OpenAPI sub-claim is affirmatively contradicted. full stands on the documented operations reference plus keyless schema output (the anthropic-skills full-8 bar), minus the contradicted contract claim and no authenticated call. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
